snippet.title: Metro Rivals: New York | Official Announce Trailer and Showcase - Coming 2026!
snippet.description:
Your Ride. Your Rivals. Your Reputation. 

Metro Rivals: New York is Coming Soon in 2026

A genre-defying subway simcade: face the Track Titans in a story-driven single-player campaign or challenge friends in intense PvP!

Wishlist Now 👉 https://metrorivals.com/

00:00:00 - Chatham, Fall 2025
00:01:12 - Metro Rivals Announce Trailer
00:02:10 - Introduction to Metro Rivals
00:03:49 - Game Modes and Multiplayer
00:05:38 - Using Unreal Engine 5
00:07:17 - Customisation
00:07:57 - Round-up and What's Next 

----------------------------------------
In a world where reputation is everything, strategy rules, and raw speed can make or break a run - welcome to Metro Rivals. A genre-defying subway simcade: face the Track Titans in a story-driven single-player campaign or challenge friends in intense PvP!
